about_the_game:
This add-on is for players who want to support development and get behind-the-scenes extras. The base game already includes all gameplay features.

Pro DLC contents

  • Original soundtrack (high-quality MP3 music files).

  • PDF technical papers & notes to see the science behind Meco’s simulation engine.

  • 3D-print files for showcase turbopump geometry generated by our prototype code (educational/desk models).

  • Hi-res “Miku” wallpapers (the game’s mascot/guide).

You must own Meco Rocket Simulator to access this content.

This DLC is still in Early Access. Here are the planned features that are included for free with future updates to this DLC:

  • Export 3D-print files of Turbopump, Nozzle, and Injector parts

  • Scriptable Custom Components

  • Scriptable Custom UI

  • Advanced fluid network solvers
